decisions.statement: A seat comes back from what the commit that took its page away left there.
The page is composed again from those values rather than written back as it was.
A value written under a name pages have left is read under the name pages have.
A seat that comes back keeps the id and the session that seat had.
Why a seat's page went is no part of whether that page comes back.
A name no commit ever took a page away from brings nothing back.
A seat whose page is there already brings nothing back.
A seat is looked for in history at the one path a seat page has now.
A page taken away from any other path brings nothing back.
A page coming back lands as a change, so the index carries that page again.
What a seat said while its page was there is read elsewhere.
A name a seat answers to is answered without reading history at all.
A name nothing brings back is refused as the resolver refused that name.

definition: a seat composed again from what its page said before that page was taken away
